location.zh: Brightway 公司，王經理辦公室

goal.en: Understand Ms. Wong's assignment and confirm every detail before you start.
goal.zh: 聽懂王經理交代的任務，開工前把細節確認清楚。

background: manager's private office with a tidy wooden desk, a desk lamp with a curved arm, a laptop with a blank screen, a bookshelf with plain binders, a large window, afternoon light

intro.en: Wednesday afternoon. Ms. Wong asks you to come to her office.
intro.zh: 星期三下午，王經理請你到她的辦公室一趟。

intro.en: Come in, Kai. Have a seat. I have your first real task.
intro.zh: 進來吧，凱，請坐。我有你的第一個正式任務。

lines.en: Our client, Harbor Café, is opening a second shop. I need a short comparison of our three pendant lights for them.
lines.zh: 我們的客戶 Harbor Café 要開第二家店。我需要你幫他們整理我們三款吊燈的簡短比較。

choices.en: Sure. Just to make sure I understand, you want price, size, and brightness side by side?
choices.zh: 好的。我確認一下，您是要把價格、尺寸和亮度並排比較嗎？
choices.tip: Just to make sure I understand... 先複述重點再確認，避免做白工。

choices.en: Okay, okay, no problem! I understand everything, so you don't need to explain more.
choices.zh: 好好，沒問題！我全部都懂了，您不用再解釋了。

lines.en: Everything? I haven't told you the format yet.
lines.zh: 全部？我還沒跟你說格式耶。

story.en: On Friday, you proudly hand in a twenty-page report. Ms. Wong wanted one page.
story.zh: 星期五，你得意地交出一份二十頁的報告。王經理要的其實只有一頁。

fail.why: 台灣新人常為了不想顯得笨，先說「沒問題、都懂了」。但北美主管更希望你當場確認：Just to make sure I understand...。

choices.en: Sure. What means comparison? You want I make a table or a slides?
choices.zh: 好。比較是什麼意思？您要我做表格還是簡報？

lines.en: A table or... a slides? Okay, let me explain this again, slowly.
lines.zh: 表格還是……一個簡報們？好，我再慢慢解釋一次。

story.en: Ms. Wong explains three times. You finally get it, but she's ten minutes late for her next meeting.
story.zh: 王經理解釋了三次，你終於懂了，但她下一個會議遲到了十分鐘。

fail.why: 問意思要說 What does comparison mean?，不是 What means...?；「您要我做」是 Do you want me to make...?；slides 是複數，不加 a。

lines.en: Exactly. Keep it to one page. They want something they can read in two minutes.
lines.zh: 沒錯，控制在一頁。他們想要兩分鐘就能看完的東西。

choices.en: Got it, one page. By when do you need it?
choices.zh: 了解，一頁。您最晚什麼時候需要？
choices.tip: By when do you need it? 問的是截止時間，by 表示「在……之前」。

choices.en: Got it. And when do I need to hand in my homework?
choices.zh: 了解。那我的作業什麼時候要交？

lines.en: Homework? Ha, it's a client document, Kai. This isn't school.
lines.zh: 作業？哈，這是給客戶的文件啦，凱。這裡不是學校。

story.en: Ms. Wong finds it funny. Unfortunately, she now calls every task you get "Kai's homework" in front of the whole team.
story.zh: 王經理覺得很好笑。可惜從此以後，她在大家面前都把你的任務叫做「凱的作業」。

fail.why: 中文說「交作業」很順口，但英文的 homework 只用在學校。工作上問期限說 By when do you need it? 或 When is it due?。

choices.en: Only one page? That's too easy. I can finish it in about ten minutes.
choices.zh: 才一頁？太簡單了吧，我大概十分鐘就能做完。

lines.en: Easy? Great. Then I'll expect it to be perfect.
lines.zh: 簡單？很好，那我就期待它很完美囉。

story.en: Your "ten-minute" page takes you all evening. Ms. Wong still finds two price mistakes.
story.zh: 你的「十分鐘」一頁做了一整個晚上，王經理還是找到兩個價格錯誤。

fail.why: 主管交代任務時說「太簡單了」聽起來很輕率。先確認期限：Got it. By when do you need it?。

lines.en: End of day Friday is fine. Oh, and use the new price list, not the old one.
lines.zh: 星期五下班前就可以。對了，要用新的價目表，不要用舊的。

choices.en: Could you clarify where the new price list is saved? I've only seen one so far.
choices.zh: 可以說明一下新的價目表存在哪裡嗎？我到目前只看過一份。
choices.tip: Could you clarify...? 請對方把某一點說清楚，比 I don't understand. 更具體、更專業。

choices.en: Where you save the new price list? I only see the old one before.
choices.zh: 您把新價目表存在哪裡？我之前只看過舊的。

lines.en: Where I save...? Oh, you mean where is it saved? Hmm, let me think.
lines.zh: 我存在……？喔，你是問它存在哪裡嗎？嗯，我想想。

story.en: Ms. Wong gets a phone call before she can answer. You can't find the new list, so you use the old one. Every price is wrong.
story.zh: 王經理還沒回答就接到電話。你找不到新的價目表，只好用舊的，結果每個價格都錯了。

fail.why: 疑問句要有助動詞：Where did you save it? 或 Where is it saved?。說過去看過要用 I've only seen... 或 I only saw...。

choices.en: Sure. By the way, don't you think the old prices were a little too expensive?
choices.zh: 好。對了，您不覺得舊的價格有點太貴嗎？

lines.en: That's... not really the point right now, Kai.
lines.zh: 這個……現在不是重點吧，凱。

story.en: After ten minutes of pricing debate, you still don't know where the new list is. You guess, and you guess wrong.
story.zh: 辯論價格辯了十分鐘，你還是不知道新價目表在哪。你用猜的，而且猜錯了。

fail.why: 主管交代細節時，先把不清楚的地方問清楚：Could you clarify where it's saved?。個人意見等任務確認完再說。

lines.en: It's in the shared drive, under Sales. Any other questions?
lines.zh: 在共用雲端硬碟的 Sales 資料夾裡。還有其他問題嗎？

choices.en: Yes. Should I send it to you first, or straight to the client?
choices.zh: 有。我要先寄給您，還是直接寄給客戶？
choices.tip: Should I... or...? 把選項說清楚，讓主管一句話就能回答。

choices.en: Yes. Can I add you on LINE? Then I can send the file to you there.
choices.zh: 有。我可以加您 LINE 嗎？這樣我就能用 LINE 傳檔案給您。

lines.en: LINE? I don't have it. We use email and the team chat here.
lines.zh: LINE？我沒有耶。我們這裡用 email 和團隊聊天群組。

story.en: You spend twenty minutes explaining what LINE is. Ms. Wong politely declines to download it.
story.zh: 你花了二十分鐘解釋 LINE 是什麼，王經理還是客氣地婉拒下載。

fail.why: 台灣職場常用 LINE 溝通，但北美公司多用 email 或 Slack、Teams 這類工具。先問清楚流程：Should I send it to you first?。

choices.en: Nope. I've got it, I've got it. You can stop worrying about it now.
choices.zh: 沒了。我懂了、我懂了，您現在可以不用擔心了。

lines.en: I'm not worried, Kai. I'm giving instructions.
lines.zh: 我沒有在擔心，凱。我是在交代工作。

story.en: You send the page straight to the client. It has a typo in the café's name, and Ms. Wong finds out from the client.
story.zh: 你把那一頁直接寄給客戶，咖啡廳的名字打錯了，王經理還是從客戶那裡才知道。

fail.why: 對主管說「您可以不用擔心了」聽起來像嫌對方囉嗦。最後確認流程：Should I send it to you first, or straight to the client?。

lines.en: Send it to me first. I'll check it before it goes out.
lines.zh: 先寄給我，我看過再寄出去。

choices.en: Sounds good. So, one page, new prices, to you by Friday at five. Is that right?
choices.zh: 好的。所以是一頁、新價格、星期五五點前寄給您，對嗎？
choices.tip: 最後把重點複述一次，再問 Is that right?，確保雙方理解一致。

choices.en: Received! I'll finish it on time, so you can put your heart down.
choices.zh: 收到！我會準時完成，您可以放心。

lines.en: Put my... heart down? I'm not sure what that means.
lines.zh: 把我的……心放下？我不太懂這是什麼意思。

story.en: Ms. Wong is so busy decoding your sentence that neither of you repeats the deadline. You send it on Monday.
story.zh: 王經理忙著解讀你的句子，你們都忘了再確認期限。結果你星期一才寄出。

fail.why: 「收到」「放心」不能直譯。英文說 Got it. 或 Sounds good.；要讓對方放心可以說 Don't worry, I'll have it ready.。

choices.en: Great! So, what are you doing this weekend? Anything fun?
choices.zh: 太好了！那您這個週末要做什麼？有好玩的嗎？

lines.en: Uh... let's focus on Friday first, shall we?
lines.zh: 呃……我們先專心處理星期五的事，好嗎？

story.en: Your mind is already on the weekend. You forget to write down the deadline and send the page on Monday morning.
story.zh: 你的心已經飛到週末，忘了記下期限，星期一早上才把檔案寄出。

fail.why: 任務交代完的最後一刻，最適合把重點複述一次：So, one page, by Friday. Is that right?。閒聊等工作確認完再說。

lines.en: Perfect. That's exactly right. Thanks, Kai.
lines.zh: 完美，完全正確。謝謝你，凱。

lines.en: On Friday at 4:30, your one-page comparison lands in Ms. Wong's inbox.
lines.zh: 星期五下午四點半，你的一頁比較表寄到了王經理的信箱。

story.en: You asked the right questions, so there was no guesswork. Ms. Wong forwards your page to the client without changing a word.
story.zh: 你問對了問題，完全不用猜。王經理一字未改，直接把你的比較表轉寄給客戶。

notes.en: Just to make sure I understand...
notes.explain: 接任務時先複述重點，對方可以馬上糾正誤會，是職場上很受歡迎的習慣。

example.en: Just to make sure I understand, you need two versions?
example.zh: 我確認一下，您需要兩個版本，對嗎？

notes.en: By when do you need it?
notes.explain: by 表示「在某時間之前」。問 By when 比只問 When 更清楚是在問截止時間。

example.en: By when do you need the slides?

notes.explain: 請對方把某一點說清楚，比 I don't understand. 更具體也更專業。後面可接名詞或 what、where 子句。

example.en: Could you clarify what you mean by "short"?
example.zh: 可以說明一下您說的「簡短」是指多短嗎？

notes.explain: 中文訊息常回「收到」，但英文口語說 Received! 很生硬，像機器回覆。改說 Got it.、Sounds good. 或 Will do.。

example.en: Got it. I'll send it by Friday.

notes.en: Asking questions is part of the job.
notes.explain: 台灣新人常怕問問題顯得笨，先說「沒問題」再自己猜。在北美職場，主管更希望你一開始就問清楚，而不是交出錯的東西。

example.en: Sorry, one more question before I start.
example.zh: 不好意思，開始之前再問一個問題。
